question.problem:
$$
B=[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ -9 & -16 & 16 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & -3 & -11 \\ 0 & 5 & 10 & 17\end{aligned}]
$$

 

If $B=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $B$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{42}\cdot {u}_{34}?$
question.worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $B$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}B & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ -9 & -16 & 16 & 3 \\ 0 & -4 & -3 & -11 \\ 0 & 5 & 10 & 17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & -4 & -3 & -11 \\ 0 & 5 & 10 & 17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-4){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & \,\,4\,\, & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 5 & 10 & 17\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ -3 & -1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & \,\,4\,\, & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -5 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}3 & 5 & -6 & -2 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{42}=-5$ and ${u}_{34}=1,$ we get

$$
{l}_{42}\cdot {u}_{33}=(-5)\cdot 1=-5.
$$
